observations: Multiple used car engines wrapped in clear plastic film.
The engines appear to be in a storage or workshop environment.
No brand or model name is visible on the engine casings in the photo.
The engine components are not clearly visible to confirm the specific 2ZR model.

claims.evidence: The engine is wrapped in plastic, so the brand and year cannot be confirmed from the photo.
The gearbox is not visible in the photo.

risks.risk: The engine may not be a 2ZR model as claimed.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine identification plate (usually on the side or front).

risks.risk: The engine may be a different year or model than the 2010 claimed.
risks.proof: A photo of the engine identification plate showing the manufacturing date.

risks.risk: The gearbox may be missing or in poor condition.
risks.proof: A photo of the gearbox and its identification plate.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the engine identification plate showing the year and model.
Photo of the gearbox if included.
Photo of the engine with the plastic wrapping removed to see the actual condition.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
